title: Cosmic Octopus Sorcerer
description: A towering magenta octopus-like sorcerer with a single large eye, wearing ornate golden and white robes, stands in the center of a swirling cosmic orb. Below, a silhouetted wizard with a staff stands on a reflective platform, gazing up at the creature as it holds a smaller orb containing three robed figures beneath a crescent moon and stars.
prompt: A majestic magenta octopus sorcerer with a single glowing eye and ornate golden robes floats at the center of a swirling cosmic orb filled with stars, a crescent moon, and colorful nebulae. The creature holds a smaller glowing orb containing three robed figures. In the foreground, a silhouetted wizard in a dark cloak stands on a reflective platform holding a staff, looking up in awe. The background features a starry night sky with constellations, pink clouds, lotus flowers, floating feathers and butterflies, and dramatic golden light beams from above.
